page_title: Turn a photo into a cross-stitch pattern

sources.entry: Cross-Stitch Studio - Turn photos into editable cross-stitch charts with DMC thread colors and optional AI photo preparation. #freemium #design

summary.name: Cross-Stitch Studio
summary.one_liner: A browser tool that converts a photo into an editable cross-stitch chart using DMC thread colors, with a free black-and-white PDF download and no account required.
keywords: black and white cross stitch pdf
use_cases: Turning a family photo or portrait into a cross-stitch project
Making a stitchable chart from a pet picture
Converting a logo or motif into a cross-stitch pattern
Stitching a pattern using the DMC skeins you already own
Planning a finished size for a small evening project on Aida fabric
summary.what_it_does: The tool converts an uploaded photo into a cross-stitch chart on a grid, with a chosen number of stitches and colors (default starting point 64 x 64 stitches and 12 colors). Colors are mapped to DMC thread codes. You can enter the DMC codes you own so the chart is built from those threads. The page describes editing the chart, a preview, and downloading a free black-and-white PDF without an account. Refinement controls include leaving a plain background unstitched, a cleanup control to reduce isolated stitches, and dithering on or off. Transparent PNG cutouts are supported, leaving transparent areas blank.
notable: Maps photo colors to DMC thread codes and lets you build the chart from threads you already own
Free black-and-white PDF download without an account
Transparent PNG cutouts leave background squares blank on the chart
Grid size and color count are adjustable; 64 x 64 at 14-count Aida is about 11.6 cm across
caveats: The page does not state what the color chart or other PDF options cost; only the black-and-white PDF is described as free
Pasting images from an iPhone depends on a compatible device and browser support
Small details such as eyes or leaves need several squares to read well
